ammonia.reason: no surface flora or prolonged proteolysis/deamination in 1-3 day lactic cheese, no NH3 quantified

animal_barnyard.reason: trace indole/p-cresol plus caprylic acids from goat milk, no Brevibacterium washed-rind metabolism

bitter.reason: minimal hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin due to very short age and low rennet dose

blue_moldy.reason: 2-heptanone 10 ug/kg, 2-nonanone 4 ug/kg, 2-undecanone 4 ug/kg from minimal fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium

browning.reason: high moisture 60.75% and unaged curd with limited Maillard precursors when heated

buttery.reason: acetoin 4830-25346 ug/kg plus diacetyl GC-O buttery from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus diacetylactis

cheesy_sweaty.reason: low butanoic 11-22 ug/kg and limited hexanoic/octanoic/decanoic lipolysis, 3-methylbutanoic only 2 ug/kg fresh

creaminess.reason: 21.08% fat dispersed in 60.75% moisture fine lactic gel gives smooth spreadable mouthfeel

crumbliness.reason: acid-demineralized calcium-depleted casein network fractures short with no rennet elasticity

firmness.reason: high-moisture lactic gel log, soft and spreadable, not pressed or aged to firm

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol only 9 ug/kg from limited phenylalanine catabolism, no ripened floral esters

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate 1 ug/kg and ethyl hexanoate 2 ug/kg, minimal esterase esterification without aging

goaty.reason: goat-specific 4-methyloctanoic 128-142 ug/kg and 4-ethyloctanoic 88-187 ug/kg far above ~2 ug/kg threshold

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines absent without cooking or aging

melt.reason: acid low-pH demineralized curd contracts and softens but does not flow on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-one mushroom GC-O only trace from linoleate oxidation, no Geotrichum maturation in plain fresh

oil_off.reason: intact milk fat globules in cold fresh matrix, very low free oil release

smoky.reason: unsmoked make, guaiacol only low sour-burnt GC-O note with no quantification

sour_vinegar.reason: lactic acid from mesophilic starter lactose fermentation plus acetic 71-198 ug/kg, pH 4.2-5.22

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata hot-kneading and no calcium-pH window for casein fiber formation

sulfur_cooked.reason: methional potato GC-O trace only, no cooked curd and minimal methionine catabolism

sweet.reason: most lactose converted to lactic acid, faint sweet from residual lactose and acetoin

umami.reason: very low free glutamate and peptides without proteolysis during 1-3 days
